answer: Convention is class name verbatim: MODEL_REFS keys are the 17 class names, values 'deskops.models:<name>' (deskops/bootstrap.py:15-31). So {name: f"deskops.models:{name}" for name in __all__}.

Dynamic top-level discovery would break the sldb-absent path: deskops/models/base.py:3 does `from sldb import StructuredNLDoc`, while bootstrap.py imports no sldb (bootstrap.py:3-11). Use a static literal (or build lazily only after sldb is importable).

Identity-only exclusion. 11 of 21 concrete docs subclass PrimitiveDoc (models/hook.py:6, condition.py:6, etc.) or via OperationalArtifactDoc (models/base.py:36; task.py:8), so excluding all subclasses drops to 10 models, not 21.
models/__init__.py:25-49 __all__ lists only 23 class names (no enums, aliases, or constants), so no extra filter rule is needed; an isinstance(x, type) guard is sufficient.

Default must be False: direct callers main.py:87,95,113,137 (materialize/drift/ops/default) must not install; ensure_machine_ready (bootstrap.py:64-65) is the only site passing True. Tests monkeypatch with `lambda self: 0` (tests/test_cli.py:451), so keep it defaulted keyword.

`deskops bootstrap` (main.py:155-156 _bootstrap) and `deskops init` (main.py:158-166 _init) both route through ensure_machine_ready (bootstrap.py:64-65), its only non-test caller. Put allow_install=True there.
No cli/* edits needed. Non-bootstrap callers stay on the default at main.py:87,95,113,137; the only True site is ensure_machine_ready inside bootstrap.py:64-65. The files list is complete.

Existing mechanism is print + return 1, not sys.exit: bootstrap.py:40 prints "Error: sldb is not installed and no sibling checkout was found." (hint at 41-43) and bootstrap.py:44 `return 1`; main propagates the code.

Root of `.sldb/core/store_index.yaml` is unstated. Fresh init writes the tmp repo's store, so read <tmp_root>/.sldb/core/store_index.yaml (or the reference repo's via ROOT). Fix: name the root; assert the file exists after init.

Hardcoding 21 drifts. Fix: assert exact set equality between the registered model names and the model set discovered from deskops.models.__all__ minus bases (or the reference store index), not a literal count.
"Exactly match" is unscoped for an index that also stores path/models_index/documents; the tmp repo tracks no documents. Fix: compare model-name sets (or model_ref) only, not whole-file YAML.

No test target for the refusal path. Fix: add a test monkeypatching _sldb_importable to False and a _run spy, asserting a read command (e.g. list/show) prints the error and returns 1 without invoking pip.

tests/test_doctor_model_registration.py already holds 4 doctor tests (unregistered-model reporting/repair) and no init test; the new fresh-init test is the only addition needed, doctor behavior is covered.

Already resolved: the task's Resolved Decisions say the _make_repo/_cli helpers are "the pattern to copy"; they are module-private test helpers (tests/test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:29,40), so duplicate them rather than import.
